summary: Frontend-only test of the Teleton intro modal (/teleton-intro.html iframe) on Android 412x915, iOS 390x844 and Desktop 1920x1080. On all 3 viewports the modal shows up, the logo, title and DOAR AGORA button are visible and fit on screen without scrolling (scrollHeight equals the viewport height), and clicking #doarAgoraBtn inside the iframe closes the modal and shows home-aacd-frame while staying on /. Desktop has no regression.

android_412x915.logo: x=143 y=27 w=126 h=67 (centered, .logo__h shown, .logo__v hidden)
android_412x915.headline: y=114-188 centered

issues: The white 'teleton' wordmark sits over a bright sky/street-sign area of the background photo, so contrast is a bit low. A subtle text-shadow or a top dark gradient would help.
The 'levar futuro' subtitle slightly overlaps the top of the green bracket graphic. This is cosmetic only.

action_items: Optional only: improve contrast of the logo wordmark on mobile with a top gradient or shadow
critical_code_review_comments: The mobile CSS relies heavily on !important overrides inside @media (max-aspect-ratio:4/5). It works, but landscape phones or tablets in portrait at around 4:5 will switch layouts at that aspect ratio. This is acceptable.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Access the iframe [data-testid=home-donate-modal] via content_frame() and use #doarAgoraBtn inside it. After the click the overlay is removed from the DOM and [data-testid=home-aacd-frame] becomes visible.
